name: G.U.S. Judicator Prime

marshal_integration.role: Command ship for Marshal-led strike forces; hosts a full Sentinel-class strike unit

notes: Primary narrative vessel; senior command roster CANON-locked. 2026-07-20: Marshal-integration attributes + approx crew added from April-2025 archive mining (owner-approved); 2026-07-21: 'supercarrier' RESOLVED as canonical hull-type descriptor of CLASS-JUDICATOR-01 (class ID unchanged, no rename); hosted-asset command doctrine JUDICATOR-HOST-001 locked by direct owner ruling. 2026-07-21 Judicator Promotion Pass: full specifications promoted (World Bible §4.2 + Ship Registry v1.0, mutually corroborating); senior-staff crew roster linked; class_entity_id bound to cls_judicator; crew-count conflict resolved in favor of ~12,000 by owner ruling. The embarked/ship's-company distinction in crew_roster_note is the roster expression of JUDICATOR-HOST-001 — Drayen is hosted, retaining his Marshal parent chain. Functional architecture JUDICATOR-ARCH-001 v1.1 remains STAGING and has been revised to treat promoted weapons, defenses, propulsion, support-craft, and cyberwarfare systems as binding design anchors.
placement_rule: no_fixed_coordinates: mobile asset holds no map placement; position is asserted per-event with a canonical route/drive citation and validated at reconciliation (P2, FABRIC_INVARIANTS v0.1; RULING-FABRIC-SCHEMA 2026-07-21)

specifications.propulsion: Dual FTL cores with emergency jump capability

crew_roster_note: Senior staff per World Bible §4.2: Tann (CO), Voss (XO), Radek (Sentinel-Commander), Kovas (CSO), Veran (CMO), Kailo (Chief Engineer), Tavos (Tactical Ops & Gunnery). Elias Drayen (Marshal-Captain, Sentinel SpecOps) is EMBARKED rather than ship's company — see marshal_integration.
crew_approx_note: RULING-JUDICATOR-CREW-COUNT (owner, 2026-07-21): ~12,000 GOVERNS. The Ship Registry v1.0 class baseline of 2,500 is superseded draft data for this vessel and is retained only on cls_judicator for lineage.

hosted_asset_command_doctrine.core_rule: The Judicator Prime may host, transport, sustain, deploy, and recover independent Union assets without absorbing them into its naval chain of command; all normal institutional chain-of-command rules continue unless a lawful mission order establishes temporary coordination authority.
hosted_asset_command_doctrine.captain_scope: Captain Alric Tann commands the vessel, including navigation, defense, launch and recovery, internal security, damage control, access control, shipboard weapons posture, and immediate safety emergencies.
hosted_asset_command_doctrine.hosted_asset_scope: Hosted Marshal, Ranger, Sentinel, diplomatic, intelligence, scientific, medical, and other specialist assets retain their parent-chain mission, personnel, discipline, and doctrine authority.
hosted_asset_command_doctrine.joint_operation_rule: Independent assets are normally tasked separately; joint employment requires a mission-specific coordinating lead, defined authority scope, or an immediate emergency.

canonical_system_anchors: Dual FTL cores with emergency jump capability
functional_architecture.carrier_model: Dual independent flight spines plus ventral heavy mission bays; tactical interceptors and a full Sentinel deployment wing are CANON, while exact capacities remain STAGING.
functional_architecture.command_model: Bridge, Combat Information Center, Flag Operations Center, Joint Operations Coordination Center, Marshal Operations Center, Sentinel Mission Control, cyberwarfare/network-defense command, and emergency battle bridge remain functionally distinct.
functional_architecture.promotion_gate: Owner review and CanonRec conflict scan required before dimensions, capacities, topology, weapon implementation, drive implementation, shield performance, armor performance, or network architecture become CANON.
